stats.name: Speed
stats.description: Movement, and through APT the action economy as well.

stats.description: Attacks Per Turn. Derived from Speed — Charactersheet!E9.

combatSkills.name: mele
combatSkills.description: Melee attack. Input is the raw Strenght stat — confirmed: input 10 at Str 10 gives 0D20 + 0D12 + 1D6 + 4.

combatSkills.name: Ranged
combatSkills.description: Ranged attack. Input is the raw Dex stat — confirmed: input 11 at Dex 11 gives 0D20 + 0D12 + 1D6 + 5.

combatSkills.name: evasion
combatSkills.description: Dodging. Input is 18 for the sample character against Dex 11 — the extra 7 is unexplained (Concept 08 open question).

combatSkills.name: endure
combatSkills.description: Soaking. Input is 16 for the sample character against Con 12 — the extra 4 is unexplained (Concept 08 open question).

constants.name: bonus_divider
constants.description: How many skill levels are worth one point of bonus. Lower makes skills matter more.

constants.name: apt_value
constants.description: Speed needed per attack per turn. Lower gives everyone more attacks at the same Speed.

constants.name: points_per_level
constants.description: Skill points a character receives for each level gained.

constants.name: race_blend_divisor
constants.description: What a blended base is divided by when a character has more than one race.

curves.name: point_buy
curves.description: What a point spent on a stat is worth, by how much the archetype favours that stat.

curves.name: xp_thresholds
curves.description: Total experience needed for each level. Read backwards: given the XP, which level. Placeholder — the sheet does not have this table.

diceLadders.name: Standard
diceLadders.description: The sheet's ladder: a value becomes D20s, then D12s, then D6s, with the leftover as a flat bonus.

rollDefinitions.name: mele
rollDefinitions.description: Melee attack. Input is the raw Strenght stat — confirmed: input 10 at Str 10 gives 0D20 + 0D12 + 1D6 + 4.

rollDefinitions.name: Ranged
rollDefinitions.description: Ranged attack. Input is the raw Dex stat — confirmed: input 11 at Dex 11 gives 0D20 + 0D12 + 1D6 + 5.

rollDefinitions.name: evasion
rollDefinitions.description: Dodging. The sheet's input is 18 against Dex 11 — the extra 7 is unexplained (Concept 08 open question), so this reads the raw stat and is 7 short.

rollDefinitions.name: endure
rollDefinitions.description: Soaking. The sheet's input is 16 against Con 12 — the extra 4 is unexplained (Concept 08 open question), so this reads the raw stat and is 4 short.
